description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the CandidateAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It defines a test class CandidateAPITest with multiple methods to test creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate records via API endpoints, utilizing data providers for test data. The class extends an endpoint integration test case framework and uses mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: CandidateAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to test the CandidateAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes various test cases for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate records using data-driven testing methods.
